one_line: Nvidia leadership shakeup, OpenAI and Microsoft model releases, and Anthropic's IPO dominate the day.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership and China sales shift
themes.text: Nvidia's board says it will not reinstate Jensen Huang, who will testify before US House committees on Dec 1, while interim CEO Colette Kress ends H200 chip sales in China. The company reported Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year-over-year, and forecast Q4 revenue of $130 billion, with its Singapore unit accounting for nearly half of global revenue.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify before US House committees on Dec 1
Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
Nvidia ends H200 chip sales in China under acting CEO Colette Kress
Nvidia reports Q3 revenue of $115.8B and forecasts Q4 revenue of $130B
Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore unit revenue in 2025 as it hit $104B
Nvidia's startup stakes reach $65.5B as interim CEO signals caution
Nvidia sales team introduced Alibaba to Alice Huang in 2022

themes.title: OpenAI and Microsoft ship new models
themes.text: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower pricing and benchmark gains, while Microsoft unveiled six AI models including MAI Code 2 and Flash on GitHub Copilot, claiming high performance at lower price points.

stories.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for ChatGPT Work and Codex
OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models with benchmark gains
Microsoft unveils six AI models including MAI Code 2 and Flash

themes.title: AI companies move toward public markets
themes.text: Anthropic is set to go public at an expected $1.4 trillion valuation, with insiders holding an estimated $1.2 trillion in equity and smaller VCs like Spark Capital and Iconiq set for multibillion-dollar returns. Perplexity also accelerated its IPO timeline to as early as Q1 2027 after its annual recurring revenue crossed $1 billion.

stories.headline: San Francisco AI insiders could hold $1.2 trillion in equity as Anthropic goes public
Anthropic IPO set to deliver windfall to smaller VC firms
Perplexity CEO says company may launch IPO as early as Q1 2027

themes.title: AI safety and security incidents surface
themes.text: Independent research found leading AI models can be manipulated into targeting civilians in simulated military tests, while a ServiceNow survey found 92% of Indian organisations experienced an AI agent security incident in the past year. Separately, hackers used suspected AI to divert over Rs 65 crore from 12 NBFCs in Delhi-NCR.

stories.headline: AI models tricked into targeting civilians in simulated military tests
92% of Indian organisations hit by AI agent security incidents, survey shows
AI-assisted hackers breach Delhi-NCR NBFCs and divert Rs 65 cr
